finding_dispositions.evidence: Independent r8 resource-accounting regression and 69-test suite passed.
Draft 2020-12 annotation propagation passed without regression.
Direct function replacement and code mutation fail, but replacing the module-global verifier can return and execute an unattested callable.
ErrorRuleRegistry remains exact, factory-only, final, deeply immutable, and rejects invalid triples.
Direct migration function replacement and code mutation fail, but mutable global dependencies used by the transform are not covered by the function-source digest.
Independent full/cross suites and exact 250-vector coverage passed.
MigrationSpec and all listed trusted objects are now factory-only/final as applicable and sealed under ordinary operations.

findings.claim: The predicate execution gate itself is replaceable.
findings.evidence: Replacing the module-global verifier selected an unattested callable while IDs and digests remained approved.
findings.required_change: Remove or seal the replaceable verifier boundary and bind the exact returned callable.

findings.claim: Migration attestation omits mutable global dependencies.
findings.evidence: Replacing versioning.thaw changed accepted output while function identity, code object, source digest, and provenance remained approved.
findings.required_change: Bind the full dependency closure or make the transform self-contained and verify all executable dependencies before calling.
